$comment: Reviewed migrations for the architecture ratchets.
A ratchet that can be widened in the same commit that creates the debt is
not a ratchet (issue #2991). These two ledgers are the only way to widen:
Every entry records the previous value, the new value, the issue that
authorises it, and a non-empty rationale. tests/unit/test_ratchets.py
rejects a ledger change that has no matching entry, and rejects an entry
whose 'from' does not match the value the ledger held before the change.
That makes widening require a deliberate, reviewable, cited act rather
than an incidental edit to a number.
Prefer paying the debt. An entry here is a debt schedule, not a fix.

module_line_ceilings.rationale: c8bff364d raised this pin in the same commit range that grew the module. Re-recorded here as approved debt so the ceiling is frozen rather than silently refreshed again. No claim is made that the module was refactored; the debt is 324 lines over the pre-growth pin and is owed a split into per-command submodules.

Two growths recorded: c8bff364d (5516→5588) and the user's PRs #2997 (Flash usage accounting), #3000/#3001 (Flash security hardening), and #3002 (concierge ownership) bringing the file to 5597. Each growth landed as a reviewable PR; the ceiling tracks the resulting size. Owed a split of the audit/serve subcommand groups out of the single CLI module.

c8bff364d (4469→4495) and the user's PR #2998 (TLS for external endpoints) growing the SDK to 4532. The auth-header seam moved and 37 lines of new TLS probe code were added. Owed a split of the receipt-verification surface and the TLS-probe surface out of the SDK module.
c8bff364d (10963→11005) and the user's PRs #2999 (source-map-js update) and #3001 (Flash hardening) growing the route table by 328 lines. Owed a split of the route table into per-domain routers.

36 lines added by the user's PR #3001 (Flash hardening: audit probes). No claim of refactor; the audit module is duplicating the route table. Owed a split where the audit module imports the route table rather than carrying its own copy.
c8bff364d (3535→3544) only. The polling/replay-cursor surface is now 9 lines over the pre-growth pin. Owed a split of the polling/replay-cursor surface out of the client module.
c8bff364d (3258→3273) and 42 lines added by the user's PR #2999 (source-map-js security update: openai-compat surface). Owed a split of the chat-completions shim from the embeddings/tool shim.
32 lines added by the user's recent wave of research-PRs (coverages/sweeps). Owed a split of the lane dispatch from the bench selection logic.

30 lines added by the user's recent catalog work (family blob registration). The module is 11283 lines over MAX_MODULE_LINES and is owed a complete split into per-family subregistries; the current ceiling is the smallest honest acknowledgement of the debt while the split is pending.

Generated file (scripts/canon_qualify.py --emit-retired-families), not human-edited. The regeneration is the appropriate size-tuning mechanism. The module is exempt from human-driven shrinking (a shrink is meaningful only when it means a non-generated file is being trimmed). Pinning the current generated size keeps the ratchet honest about what is owed if the file grows further.

arch_baselines.rationale: Added in 141f91270 when the HF-RV implementation landed. The realized layer should not depend on models.*; the shared bipower_variation/lee_mykland_jump math should be either moved down to a foundation leaf or imported lazily. The lazy-import path was rejected by arch-guard because the import is module-scope for clarity, so a baseline was the honest acknowledgement. The HF-RV design memo (docs/HF_RV_DESIGN.md) tracks the math-relocation follow-up.
